trimmed mean on a 5‑model stable pool
test a weighted combination on the small stable pool (pool4) using inverse_error weights to see if a simpler weighting on a reduced set improves over trimmed_mean or mean.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combo using the top‑k‑mean‑per‑horizon handle (w7) on the full pool to capture horizon‑specific strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8842. Series context: trend strength 0.8766 and seasonal strength 0.1395; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.025); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.3.
